item.title: Asyncio in PyScript
item.description: When running Python in a terminal or desktop, there's a myriad of ways to allow your code to do multiple things at once. You can spin off a new thread to handle computations, create a new process to offload work to other CPUs, even load up a while new subinterpretter (someday!) to execution more code.
